title: Frontend Audit & Decision - Merge Two Web Apps
brief: Audit the two active PRISM frontend builds, choose a single canonical frontend target, and publish the merge/migration plan that downstream convergence work must follow.
extension_note: Original P0 (April 2026) decided canonical=mcp-server/web vs legacy PRISM/web. P1 (May 2026) audits the two NEW pending-merge trees (cqask + mcp-cadquery) that appeared after P0 closed.

status_history.reason: P1 audit published; mcp-cadquery=drop-in (Phase B half-day) + cqask=rewrite (Phase C 2-3 days) + Phase D PSN-gap + Phase E iOS+Android Capacitor scoped. All operator-gated.

rationale: mcp-server/web is the active routed ERP/business shell and already anchors APPW-MS8 route-count assumptions.

mcp-server/web already contains the reusable CAD/programming primitives that should back machine-page convergence: LatheSketch2D, FeatureEditorPanel, WireEdmContourPicker, WireEdmContour3D, CalculatorProgramWorkbench, and Viewer3D.
The legacy web app still contains useful donor machine-page surfaces, but it is no longer the right deployment target and should be absorbed selectively.
confirmed_gaps: No unified CAD window is mounted across the dedicated machine pages in the canonical app.
The old wire studio sketch entry is unfinished and still marked coming soon.
Feature selection exists today, but feature avoid/fill/modify flows are not yet exposed as one shared machine-page workspace contract.
merge_direction: Keep mcp-server/web as the only canonical frontend.
Use H:/PRISM/web as a donor surface for machine-page CAD/workflow capabilities that are still missing from the canonical app.
Promote calculator CAD/editor surfaces into dedicated machine pages instead of leaving them calculator-only.
